attestation: I read AGENTS.md §1 for orientation only (it was also shown to me as session context, which includes the rest of the file; I did not act on its start-up reading list) and otherwise read only common.md, inventory.md, decisions.md, w3.md and t12-setup.js in comb-82/briefs, plus the rig scripts env.sh and walk.mjs (and the walk folder listing). I did not open docs/architecture, docs/decisions entries, the spec, other roadmap files, .prototype/, git history, web source, the C82 captures, or other auditors' outputs; a directory listing of comb-82/ showed that findings/ and walkthroughs/ already held w1.json and w2.json and that a core-tasks.json exists, which I did not open. I met no earlier audit's ids or wording. Evidence comes only from my own keyboard walk at 1440x900 in dark theme as Demo User. I opened the development panel once (Ctrl+Shift+D) to look for an agent-connect control and saved no friction note and never called the notes endpoint. Scratch helpers (k.mjs, add.py, temporary JSON) live in apps/e2e/ux-output/walk/w3/; two temporary JSON files were briefly written to /tmp in T02 and deleted at once. At the end I stopped my daemon with common.md § 4's stop commands and ports 4324 and 5324 were reported released.

findings.surface: project workspace › project header › h1 (focus after creating a project)
findings.state: just created a project from the sidebar form
evidence: apps/e2e/ux-output/walk/w3/004-t01-after-create.png (the h1 'Garden plan' framed by a full-width orange 2px box, same ring as the inputs)
activeElement H1 tabindex=-1, :focus-visible true, outline solid 2px rgb(255,173,127)
repro: 2. Tab 6 times to the sidebar 'New project' (+) and press Enter
findings.expected: After arriving on the new project, the title reads as a heading; a box that looks like a text field signals something to type into.
findings.actual: Focus lands on the h1 with :focus-visible, which draws the same 2px orange box used on text inputs across the full header width, so the title looks like an editable field; typing does nothing.
findings.heuristic: Nielsen #4 Consistency and standards (input focus ring vs. heading focus ring)

computed: the field's disabled=false, readOnly=false; Tab order during the failure is Rename Task List → field → Add task → Try again (the field and its primary button come before the recovery action)
repro: 2. run the T12 setup (task list read fails once)
3. Tab to the Task List and look at the add field and button
findings.expected: While a list cannot be shown, adding to it is either unavailable or clearly separate from the failure, and the recovery action comes first.
findings.actual: The add field and its primary-coloured button stay enabled above the error and are reached before Try again, inviting the user to add into a list whose contents they cannot see. (What an add does in this state was not tried: the failure is lifted after setup.)
